item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 07/Nov/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh northeast monsoon will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, a broad band of clouds will bring rainy weather to the region and the northern part of the South China Sea. With the anticyclone aloft strengthening, it will become fine and warm during the day over southern China in the middle and latter parts of this week. Another surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach southern China early next week.
